newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka closes weaker as call money eases.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka closes weaker as call money eases.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka finished weaker at 43.2950/2990 to the dollar in interbank trading on Monday as call rates eased, lifting demand for the U.S. currency, dealers said.
The local unit was quoted at 43.2920/2980 per dollar in early trade but most deals were done at the 43.2960/2970 level.

Dealers said the market had been active as the drop in call rates prompted importers to buy a substantial amount of the U.S. currency. Call money was traded at 6.5 to 7.5 percent against Sunday's 9-11 percent. -- Dhaka Newsroom +880-2-506363
